blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Central Visayas will experience cloudy skies with scattered rain showers and thunderstorms on Friday, October 2, as the trough of Severe Tropical Storm Choi-Wan affects the region. The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa), in its regional weather forecast for the Visayas issued at 5 a.m. Friday, said Central Visayas, along with Western Visayas and the Negros Island Region, will have cloudy skies with scattered rains and thunderstorms due to the trough.
